method: Extend existing repo-native SVG room source and reuse lot4 generated textures; no new image generation call.
scene_spec: Warm Vietnamese rental room shell, 8x8, fixed kitchen [0,0,5,1], bathroom [5,0,3,3], open foreground, cream back walls, honey wood, sage curtain, pale aqua bathroom. Thin brown #4a3b33 ink, soft low-contrast wash, no shadows outside objects, no text, no brands, no loose furniture. Runtime normalized floor corners [50,30.25],[92.5,59],[50,87.75],[7.5,59]. Separate canonical 2:1 sibling. Native source extended from assets/source/build-room.cjs and lot4/render.cjs.

inherited_material_prompts.name: Gỗ mật ong
inherited_material_prompts.subject: A seamless subtle warm honey wood surface wash, faint flowing hand-painted grain, very low contrast, no plank boundaries, no nails, no furniture. Colors cream #fbf3e2 and honey #d9a066, watercolor pencil storybook texture.
inherited_material_prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: seamless flat material texture swatch to be projected onto mathematically exact isometric game floor geometry. Fill the WHOLE square edge to edge with this flat material, straight top-down orthographic view, no perspective, no horizon, no objects, no borders, no text, logos, lighting gradients, specular highlights or cast shadows. Uniform warm storybook pastel color, very subtle watercolor/colored-pencil wash only; must tile quietly. This is ONLY a material surface, not a room plan or diagram.
Surface: A seamless subtle warm honey wood surface wash, faint flowing hand-painted grain, very low contrast, no plank boundaries, no nails, no furniture. Colors cream #fbf3e2 and honey #d9a066, watercolor pencil storybook texture.
